svg.title: Shoshin, beginner’s mind
svg.desc: The kanji 初心 write themselves in 975 points of light, stroke by stroke. Beside them: shoshin, beginner’s mind. Sho means first, shin means heart or mind: meet every problem as if for the first time.

g.text: Meet every problem as if for the first time:
open, eager, free of the expert’s blinders.
2,662 commits this year, still a beginner.
THE ONLY DECORATION IS THE WORD · 975 POINTS OF LIGHT
